name: Is DIY window weatherproofing effective, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Is DIY window weatherproofing effective, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While some basic weatherproofing tasks like applying temporary window film or simple draft stoppers can be done DIY, professional weatherproofing offers superior, longer-lasting results. Professionals have the right tools, experience with various materials, and knowledge to identify subtle air leaks and structural issues. Improper application can lead to ineffective sealing, wasted effort, and even trapping moisture, potentially causing more damage. For comprehensive and durable weatherproofing, especially for older homes or multiple windows, hiring an expert is recommended.
acceptedAnswer.description: DIY is okay for minor fixes, but professionals ensure effective, durable sealing, identify hidden issues, and prevent potential damage from improper application.
